text:
Predicates:
ProfessionalPlayer(x) ::: x is a professional basketball player.
American(x) ::: x is an American national.
JumpShot(x) ::: x can do jump shots.
Leaps(x) ::: x leaps straight into the air.
ActivateLegMuscles(x) ::: x activates their leg muscles.
Yuri ::: the individual named Yuri.
Premises:
∃x (ProfessionalPlayer(x) ∧ ¬American(x)) ::: Some professional basketball players are not American nationals.
∀x (ProfessionalPlayer(x) → JumpShot(x)) ::: All professional basketball players can do jump shots.
∀x (JumpShot(x) → Leaps(x)) ::: If someone can do jump shots, they leap straight into the air.
∀x (Leaps(x) → ActivateLegMuscles(x)) ::: If someone leaps straight into the air, they activate their leg muscles.
¬ActivateLegMuscles(Yuri) ::: Yuri does not activate his leg muscles.
Conclusion:
Yuri ::: the individual named Yuri.
∧ ::: conjunction (implying the statement to evaluate).
